meta.name: PASTI Design Tokens
meta.scope: Reusable numeric primitives only — colors, typography, spacing, radius, borders, opacity, motion duration/easing, breakpoints, layout/grid constants. Section-specific values (scroll distances, project/card/fragment counts, rhythm vocabularies) live in 04-homepage-spec.md, not here — see 03-design-system.md §14 for the full exclusion list.

yellow.role: Rare signature PASTI signal. Brand-level recommended presence: 1-3% (see 00-brand-guide.md §05). Homepage-execution default posture: off unless a section explicitly justifies use (see 03-design-system.md §9).

typography.note: Exact production font family is not yet decided. Do not choose a final font file without explicit approval — see 02-design-direction.md §6.

spacing.note: 8px base grid. 4px permitted only for micro-spacing — see 03-design-system.md §2.

sectionRhythm.note: Vertical spacing between sections — reusable system default, not a section-specific choreography value.

radius.note: Reconciled against Brand Guide §10 (buttons 6-8px, cards 8-12px) per the consolidation conflict-resolution principle: the token is corrected to conform to the Brand Guide, not the other way around. Previous v1.0.0 values (sm:6px / md:10px / lg:20px) partially diverged from this guidance and are superseded here — see 05-changelog.md. `button` and `card` are the primary semantic radius tokens; `sm` and `md` are compatibility/general-purpose aliases for radius needs outside buttons/cards (e.g. small Signal markers) and do NOT establish a broad arbitrary radius scale. Do not introduce `lg`, `xl`, or similar tiers unless a future Design System decision explicitly requires them — the old `lg: 20px` token is intentionally not restored.

grid.note: 12-column conceptual macro grid — see 03-design-system.md §1. Column spans and key-line usage per section are a Homepage Spec decision, not a token.

rules.cyanOnWhite: Cyan Spark #06B6D4 must not be used as readable text directly on #FFFFFF without sufficient dark containment or verified contrast treatment.
rules.yellow: Exact production HEX must be sampled from the official PASTI master logo. Do not guess the official brand value.
rules.spacingGrid: Use an 8px base grid. 4px is permitted only for micro-spacing.
rules.motion: Every movement must serve Reveal, Focus, Progress, Transition, or Response.
rules.antiTemplate: Do not default to generic SaaS grids, AI gradient blobs, giant glass cards, browser mockup stacks, or fade-up-everywhere animation.
